description: Create the two new plugin docs: plugins/README.md and plugins/AUTHORING.md. Both must make the Suno Studio framing explicit throughout: these are Suno Studio audio-effect plugins, post-render audio processors used inside Suno's in-app effects/mixing environment, applied to generated/rendered audio, NOT lyric tags and NOT part of the text-prompt/Style-Lyrics pipeline. Depends on FEAT-001 (the six plugins must exist to reference them).
steps: CREATE plugins/README.md. Open with a prominent statement: these are Suno Studio audio-effect plugins — post-render audio processors used inside Suno Studio (Suno's in-app effects/mixing environment), applied to generated/rendered audio. State clearly they are NOT lyric tags and NOT part of the text-prompt / Style-Lyrics pipeline (that pipeline is the rest of this repo; these plugins are a separate, downstream concern).

In plugins/README.md add a 'How to use in Suno Studio' section: describe generically how to load a plugin JSON into Suno Studio (import the .plugin.json into the Suno Studio effects/plugin interface and apply it to a rendered track), and NOTE that the user should confirm the exact import steps in their Suno Studio UI because the import UX is not documented here.

In plugins/README.md add a mapping TABLE with columns Plugin | What it does | KB use-case / song examples it serves. Rows: Intimate Proximity -> intimate close-mic across the vulnerable lane and Three in the Morning; De-Esser -> breathy close-mic vocals prone to sibilance (same vulnerable/intimate lane); Vintage / Lo-Fi Voicer -> lo-fi/vintage: Three in the Morning + lo-fi indie lane (analog warmth / 70s / 90s-Bristol); Digital Degrade / Glitch -> Fractured Shadows Act 1 (digital degradation / corrupted signal / progressive glitch, MODE C); Telephone / Radio Band -> Shadow Weaver / AI-voice / robotic layers (telephone-filtered, cold-clinical broadcast); Vocal Drive / Edge -> Rikan personas / Maren Storm (rasp, vocal-fry, strained-breaking character).

In plugins/README.md add a 'Tier 1 (built) vs Tier 2 (pending API confirmation)' section. Tier 1 = the six built plugins (list them). Tier 2 = ideas that need unconfirmed primitives and are therefore NOT built yet: reverb/delay/space effects, analog noise / vinyl-crackle / tape-hiss beds, SFX synthesis (and any LFO/oscillator/FFT-dependent effects). Explain they are deferred until the corresponding g.* primitives are confirmed to exist in Suno Studio.

In plugins/README.md add a prominent 'UNVERIFIED — test in Suno Studio before relying on these' callout: the plugin format and primitive list were reverse-engineered from a single working example, the plugins cannot be executed outside Suno Studio, and each should be tested in Suno Studio before production use.

CREATE plugins/AUTHORING.md. Document the reverse-engineered Suno Studio plugin JSON schema in detail: the top-level fields (id, kind, displayName, description, ports with audioIn/audioOut/extraInputs/extraOutputs, parameters, source with lang/metadata/code, ui), the parameters[] shapes (continuous range/scale/default/unit vs enumOptions toggle), the source.metadata controls map + ui.compact, the source.code build(g, config) contract (g.input/g.output/g.input('audioInL'/'audioInR'), config.sampleRate), and the ui.compact grid layout (unit 'gr', boxes with x/y/w/h referencing paramName).

In plugins/AUTHORING.md include the CONFIRMED g.* PRIMITIVES list verbatim: g.input, g.output, g.zero, g.constant, g.mul, g.add, g.sub, g.div, g.abs, g.max, g.min, g.clamp, g.lerp(mask,a,b), g.compareLt(a,b), g.dbToLin, g.tanh, g.biquad({input,cutoff,resonance,mode}), g.asymmetricOnePole({target,attackCoef,releaseCoef}). Explicitly FLAG that this list is derived from ONE example and is therefore incomplete: unconfirmed primitives (delay lines, reverb, noise generators, LFO/oscillators, FFT) are NOT known to exist and MUST NOT be used until verified in Suno Studio.

In plugins/AUTHORING.md add authoring guidance for future plugins: keep JSON valid and structurally parallel to the existing six, always include a bypass toggle + input/output gain + tanh output-safety stage + dry/wet where sensible, start source.code with a signal-chain header comment, and if an idea needs an unconfirmed primitive, list it under Tier 2 in plugins/README.md instead of building it.
Do NOT use em dashes anywhere in the new docs. Use markdown tables and code blocks consistent with the rest of the repo.
acceptance_criteria: plugins/README.md exists and states, near the top, that these are Suno Studio audio-effect plugins applied post-render and are NOT lyric tags / NOT part of the text-prompt pipeline.

plugins/README.md contains a load/use-in-Suno-Studio section, the 6-row plugin->use-case mapping table, a Tier 1 vs Tier 2 section listing the deferred reverb/delay/noise/SFX ideas, and a prominent UNVERIFIED callout.

plugins/AUTHORING.md exists, documents the full reverse-engineered schema, lists the confirmed g.* primitives, and explicitly flags the list as incomplete/derived-from-one-example with unconfirmed primitives forbidden.
No em dashes appear in either new doc.
verification: grep -n 'Suno Studio' plugins/README.md plugins/AUTHORING.md (must appear in both)
grep -ni 'post-render\|not lyric\|not part of the' plugins/README.md (framing present)
grep -n '\u2014' plugins/README.md plugins/AUTHORING.md (should find no em dashes)
findings: Expanded plugins/README.md (kept the existing Suno Studio / post-render / not-lyric-tags framing, UNVERIFIED note, layout tree, plugin file shape, and DSP primitives) and added the four missing pieces: (1) a 'How to use in Suno Studio' section with a generic import/apply flow plus an explicit note to confirm exact import steps in the user's own Suno Studio UI; (2) a 6-row mapping table (Plugin | What it does | KB use-case / song examples it serves) matching FEAT-002 exactly, including Intimate Proximity -> vulnerable lane + Three in the Morning, De-Esser -> breathy close-mic sibilance, Vintage/Lo-Fi Voicer -> Three in the Morning + lo-fi indie lane, Digital Degrade -> Fractured Shadows Act 1 MODE C, Telephone/Radio Band -> Shadow Weaver/AI-voice/robotic, Vocal Drive/Edge -> Rikan personas/Maren Storm; (3) a 'Tier 1 (built) vs Tier 2 (pending API confirmation)' section listing the six built plugins as Tier 1 and reverb/delay/space, analog noise/vinyl-crackle/tape-hiss beds, SFX synthesis, and LFO/oscillator/FFT ideas as deferred Tier 2. Created plugins/AUTHORING.md documenting the full reverse-engineered top-level JSON schema (id/kind/displayName/description/ports/parameters/source/ui), the parameters[] continuous-vs-toggle shapes, source.metadata controls map + ui.compact, the build(g, config) contract (g.input/g.output/audioInL/audioInR, config.sampleRate, bypass via g.lerp, dbToLin, tanh safety), and the ui.compact grid (unit 'gr', boxes with x/y/w/h + paramName). AUTHORING.md includes the confirmed g.* primitive list verbatim and explicitly flags it as derived from ONE example and incomplete, with delay/reverb/noise/LFO/oscillator/FFT forbidden until verified, plus authoring guidance for future plugins. Verification: grep confirms 'Suno Studio' in both files, UNVERIFIED callout, Tier 2 section, and 'Three in the Morning' present; no em dashes in either doc (grep for U+2014 returns nothing). This is a docs-only change; no build/test applies beyond the JSON validation already covered by FEAT-001.
